queries.query: Find research on structural biology from India where the publication year is greater than 2025 and the techniques used include MX or SAXS.
Find studies on mixed Thorium/Uranium oxide thin films where the research was conducted in March 2023 and the planned release date is in 2026.
Search for studies on the Mn-H system where the pressure is up to 150 GPa and the expected results will be released on January 22, 2027.
Look for research on the kinetics of electrooxidation of platinum where the study focuses on Pt(111) and Pt(100) and the publication year is greater than 2026.
Search for research on coseismic fault slip where the project is funded by the European Research Council and the publication year is 2027.
Look for studies on platinum-rare earth nanoalloys where the publication year is 2027 and the focus is on their stability during fuel cell operation.
Look for datasets related to oil-in-water microswimmers where the measurement technique is SAXS and the publication year is 2024.
Look for datasets related to RIXS on Ce Kondo lattices where the findings will be publicly available after March 7, 2025.
Find research on structural biology focusing on macromolecular crystallography conducted at Umeå University, with a release date set for March 11, 2025.
Find research on large assemblies involved in chromosome organization and transcription control where the publication year is 2025 and there are at least 17 publications reported.
Find datasets related to detector test data from the BrightnESS project where the dataset size is greater than 141 GB and the publication year is 2018.
Find datasets related to detector test data collected in 2018 under the BrightnESS project where the dataset size is less than 30 MB and the creation location is SoNDe.
Look for studies on MnPS3 where the experimental energy is measured in meV and the publication year is 2019.
Look for studies on the quasi-one-dimensional Spin-1/2 antiferromagnet SrCo2V2O8 where the experimental energy is between 0 and 5 meV and the publication year is 2018.

Search for studies on antiferromagnetic exchange interactions in dinuclear transition metal complexes where the publication year is 2018 and the experimental parameters include metallophilic Pt-Pt contacts.
Look for studies on the crystallization of para-aminobenzoic acid where the publication year is 2015 and the sample includes ethanol-d6.
Find studies on Mn-based rare-earth-free permanent magnets where the experiment energy is greater than 5A and the environment temperature is room temperature.
Search for studies on the structural determination of PAMAM dendrimer/SDS complexes where the publication year is 2013 and the sample includes poly(amidoamine) dendrimer generation 2.
Look for research related to magnetic field mapping conducted with the PANEDM instrument in 2018.
